sentences.text: Andy Warhol -LRB- -LSB- ˈwɔrhɒl -RSB- born Andrew Warhola ; August 6 , 1928 -- February 22 , 1987 -RRB- was an American artist , director and producer who was a leading figure in the visual art movement known as pop art .	visual art movement	Art movement	pop art	pop art

His works explore the relationship between artistic expression , celebrity culture , and advertising that flourished by the 1960s , and span a variety of media , including painting , silkscreening , photography , film , and sculpture .	celebrity culture	celebrity culture	advertising	advertising	silkscreening	silkscreening

Some of his best known works include the silkscreen paintings Campbell 's Soup Cans -LRB- 1962 -RRB- and Marilyn Diptych -LRB- 1962 -RRB- , the experimental film Chelsea Girls -LRB- 1966 -RRB- , and the multimedia events known as the Exploding Plastic Inevitable -LRB- 1966 -- 67 -RRB- .	Chelsea Girls	Chelsea Girls	Exploding Plastic Inevitable	Exploding Plastic Inevitable	Marilyn Diptych	Marilyn Diptych	multimedia	multimedia
Born and raised in Pittsburgh , Warhol initially pursued a successful career as a commercial illustrator .	Pittsburgh	Pittsburgh	commercial illustrator	commercial illustrator
After exhibiting his work in several galleries in the late 1950s , he began to receive recognition as an influential and controversial artist .	galleries	art gallery

His New York studio , The Factory , became a well-known gathering place that brought together distinguished intellectuals , drag queens , playwrights , Bohemian street people , Hollywood celebrities , and wealthy patrons .	New York	New York City	The Factory	The Factory	Bohemian	Bohemianism	Hollywood	Hollywood

He promoted a collection of personalities known as Warhol superstars , and is credited with coining the widely used expression `` 15 minutes of fame . ''	Warhol superstars	Warhol superstars	15 minutes of fame	15 minutes of fame

In the late 1960s , he managed and produced the experimental rock band The Velvet Underground and founded Interview magazine .	experimental rock	experimental rock	The Velvet Underground	The Velvet Underground	Interview	Interview (magazine)
He authored numerous books , including The Philosophy of Andy Warhol and Popism : The Warhol Sixties .	The Philosophy of Andy Warhol	The Philosophy of Andy Warhol
He is also notable as a gay man who lived openly as such before the gay liberation movement .	gay	gay	gay liberation movement	gay liberation
After a gallbladder surgery in 1987 , Warhol died in February of that year at the age of 58 .	gallbladder	gallbladder	surgery	surgery
Warhol has been the subject of numerous retrospective exhibitions , books , and feature and documentary films .	exhibitions	art exhibition	feature	I Shot Andy Warhol

The Andy Warhol Museum in his native city of Pittsburgh , which holds an extensive permanent collection of art and archives , is the largest museum in the United States dedicated to a single artist .	Pittsburgh	Pittsburgh	The Andy Warhol Museum	The Andy Warhol Museum
Many of his creations are very collectible and highly valuable .

The highest price ever paid for a Warhol painting is US$ 105 million for a 1963 canvas titled `` Silver Car Crash -LRB- Double Disaster -RRB- '' ; his works include some of the most expensive paintings ever sold .	canvas	canvas	most expensive paintings ever sold	List of most expensive paintings
